quality_rules: Current-site reality overrides generic AI aesthetics.
Do not invent missing structural members merely to make the image look complete.
Do not omit members clearly visible in the current-site reference.
No generic toy-like miniature or low-poly prop
Show believable material thickness, joints, fasteners, supports and load paths
Use user/site reference photos for A-grade structural assets when available
NEW PSI is the only readable brand identity when branding is naturally required
Do not mark final until visual approval and repository binary verification are both complete

system_shoring_override.mandatory_reference: Use the user's current system-shoring site photos as the geometry reference.
must_show: jack base and sole/support plate condition
vertical standard and horizontal ledger grid
horizontal stabilizing member maintaining U-head/bearer balance where used in the field reference
realistic working platform/deck arrangement where applicable
reject: missing horizontal stabilization that exists in the supplied field configuration
generic scaffold substituted for the actual system-shoring configuration
system_shoring_override.source_priority: user current-site photos > Korean safety/manufacturer guidance > generic imagery

execution_reasoning: SECTION 2 first because live user reference photos are available for system shoring and current visual direction is already being calibrated there.
Then AL Form and gangform because they are core high-rise structural-cycle gameplay assets.
Then foundation, roof/transition, finishing, and finally setup/common support assets.
This order optimizes reference reuse and style consistency rather than construction chronology.
